description: END21, synthetic in G001's shape: Teams' compact view hides the Leave control 10 minutes in, which opens a hold under a live mic that sits there for 40 minutes (the veto keeps it from confirming); the call then ends for real, the mic releases at 3000 and the window goes at 3005, and the pair confirms 60 s after the release (the Leave button and the window are one evidence class, ended since 600).
